name: Bill Ackman
zh_summary: @BillAckman 分享關於 $FNMA 與 $FMCC 的良好摘要：釋放必須盡快發生以免利潤成為政治武器，當前估值相對於資本荒謬，可透過 SPS 轉換實現偽擔保，Bill 的正確會計加紐交所重新上市計劃可透過行政行動實現，基本情形為高 40 至 $50，最不對稱的設定。
en_summary: @BillAckman shares a good summary of key points on $FNMA and $FMCC: release must happen soon so profits are not political weapons, current valuations absurd relative to capital, pseudo guarantee via SPS conversion, Bill's plan of proper accounting plus NYSE relisting feasible via executive action, base case high 40s to $50, most asymmetric setup.
